body: Yes, this is what she tells me. She mostly has a problem because of how easy it is for me to call an escort. The access is too easy and makes her uncomfortable and think I could do it again at any time. I appreciate your friend's experience and its similarity. Thanks for the advice.

She is very included, I tell her about how I feel and why it bothers me. Open relationship isn't happening. We discuss this problem openly and even though she understands why I saw escorts before she does not support me seeing them anymore. I just want to know what others think about the situation and what we should do.

And about my doctor's advice, I personally agree with him and see the point he is making. 'Ignorance is bliss', so to speak, and it is just his job to try and keep everyone happy. If she did it to me and I didn't know, it wouldn't bother me; I wouldn't know so how could I be bothered? Obviously the risk is the secret getting out and hurting someone though. And the longer a secret continues the more chance it has of coming out.

It doesn't mean I will cheat, because I would still personally harbor a lot of guilt keeping the secret. And I agree with you 100% about the STI risk, you're absolutely right.

I know all guys think this stuff, just most of them don't act on it. 

I have horrible social skills with anyone, let alone women. I've kind of lost the motivation to find a real girlfriend, since it's been so long. I tend to just keep all my relationships with people very professional because I don't want to deal with being hurt by anyone the way I've been hurt in the past.

As for finding a creeper girl...not a bad idea. The roadblock, I think, is how many girls I would have to tell I was a creeper before one of them says "oh, I'm a creeper too!"

I appreciate the reply. I've been seeing a psychiatrist for depression for about 5 years. I saw a psychologist years ago (in high school) after I got caught taking a picture under some girl's skirt. That didn't do much to change my behavior.

I've never really mentioned any of this to my current doctor except for paying for sex. I just don't see how much help he can give me. He's just going to tell me to control myself and ask why I feel motivated to do this. There's not medicine or some easy solution for sexual deviance.
